item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `PromptOptimizer.compile(..., num_trials=...)` and `WeightOptimizer.compile(..., num_batches=...)`, and each stores the kwargs it received."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses a minimal `dspy.Module` with `dspy.Predict(\"input -> output\")`, instantiates it, and sets a `DummyLM` before compilation."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Instantiates `BetterTogether(metric=..., p=..., w=...)`, runs strategy `\"p -> w\"`, and passes per-step `optimizer_compile_args` for `p` and `w`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Includes a second compile call with `{\"p\": {\"num_batches\": 99}}` and asserts it raises `ValueError` mentioning invalid args for optimizer `p`."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"The repro makes routing visible by passing shared inputs plus step-specific args and showing each optimizer records only accepted parameters, which demonstrates per-optimizer filtering before `compile()` is called."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the prompt optimizer received only `trainset` and `num_trials=10`, and the weight optimizer received only `trainset` and `num_batches=5`."},{"claim_id":"c7","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `eval_candidate_program`, `launch_lms`, and `kill_lms`, and overrides `_models_changed` to `False` to keep the repro offline and side-effect free."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
